name: omk
description: Multi-agent orchestration with intelligent model routing across specialized agents and skills (Kimi Code native)

interface.longDescription: Multi-agent orchestration with intelligent model routing across specialized agents and skills. Brings the omc (oh-my-claudecode) workflow to Kimi Code CLI with 39 skills, 21 slash commands, 19 subagents, 11 hook events, 25 hook commands, and a default-enabled 57-tool MCP server.
